facts.content: Patient reports breathing difficulties after a wasp sting about 15 minutes ago while gardening.
facts.source_text: CC: Breathing difficulties after wasp sting ~15 min ago while gardening

facts.content: Patient reports shallow breaths and chest tightness after the wasp sting.
Patient reports tingling lips without definite swelling and denies throat tightness.
facts.source_text: • Tingling lips (no definite swelling), denies throat tightness

facts.content: This is a new onset event with no prior similar episodes.
facts.source_text: • New onset, no prior similar episodes

facts.content: A mild blotchy rash has been observed.
Patient has a history of eczema.
Patient has a history of aerosinusitis.
Patient has antihistamines available at home.
Patient's wife is present at home.
No physical examination findings were performed or reported.
No vitals or diagnostic tests were discussed.
There is a possible anaphylactic reaction following a wasp sting characterized by breathlessness, chest tightness, tingling lips, and rash.
facts.source_text: 1. Possible anaphylactic reaction post wasp sting (breathlessness, chest tightness, tingling lips, rash)

facts.content: Patient is assessed as having an allergy to penicillin.
Patient is advised to call an ambulance immediately for hospital transfer.
facts.source_text: • Advise immediate ambulance call for hospital transfer

facts.content: Patient is instructed to take the available antihistamine while awaiting the ambulance.
facts.source_text: • Instruct patient to take available antihistamine while awaiting ambulance

facts.content: Plan includes monitoring for progression of symptoms en route to the hospital.
